title: fix(plugin-kanban): a card move on a read-only external object says the table is read-only, not that you lack permission
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVWpRnE3E33m6sXj7FL8vXA)_

Fixes #30410

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：看板拖动卡片被服务端以 EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN（外部数据源只读表）拒绝时，提示改为「这张表是只读的：它的记录来自外部数据源，不接受修改。」，与表单、删除、行内编辑、日历等七处一致。
- 为什么改：以前提示「您无权执行此操作」，管理员会去翻权限集，而任何权限集都解不开这张表。
- 风险与回滚：只按错误码 EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN 换文案；作者标注的 userMessage 仍优先，其他 403 与其他错误一字不变；回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx 卡片移动 catch 里的 refusal 三元式；ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.markedRefusalToast.test.tsx 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.markedRefusalToast.test.tsx`，预期 8 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx`, the card-move `catch` (the `const refusal =` expression): `isExternalWriteRefusal(err)` (`@object-ui/react`, added by #30403) is now asked after `declaredUserMessage(err)` and before `isPermissionError(err)`, and answers `form.readOnlyExternalSource`. This is byte-for-byte the order of the calendar reschedule door in `ObjectCalendar.tsx`, the closest sibling.

Order measured across #30403's seven doors (merge commit `a91409c42`): every door that reads `declaredUserMessage` asks it FIRST, before `isExternalWriteRefusal` (form page `refusalText`, record dialog in `form.tsx`, stage change `stageRefusalLines`, calendar reschedule); the three doors that ask `isExternalWriteRefusal` without a `declaredUserMessage` (record header delete, list row delete, inline edit) never read the marking at all. So an author-marked `userMessage` still wins here too. Every other 403 keeps `errors.unauthorized`.

Out of scope, untouched (claim fence): the lane-refusal paths and every other kanban refusal.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing harness `ObjectKanban.markedRefusalToast.test.tsx` (real `onDragEnd`, error built through `normaliseClientError`):

- an unmarked `403 EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN` (`code` plus `details.code`) toasts the read-only line, and not the gate's diagnostic;
- a marked one still toasts the marking.

The plain-403 control is the file's existing "keeps the localized substitution for an UNMARKED 403", still green.

## Acceptance notes

- None beyond the fence above.
